newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures fall as LME disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures fall as LME disappoints.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed lower across the board on Wednesday as individual investors were disappointed over the metal's performance in London overnight, traders said.

"If the metal's price drops again on the LME later today, we'll see quite a lot of stop-loss selling tomorrow," one trader said. "Tokyo prices had been quite resilient recently, but they are finally taking falls in London seriously."
TOCOM benchmark April 1998 shed 3.7 yen to 191.7 yen per kg, while other contracts dropped between 3.1 and 4.5 yen.
The estimated volume climbed to 3,510 lots, compared with 1,452 lots on Tuesday.
LME three months aluminium fell $18 to $1,578 per tonne overnight, failing to hold above the key $1,600 level.
